Keep the door attached to its hinge and preserve the opposite door leaf. Brief camera vibration only at impact, no orbit.

The entire visible water path must be in unobstructed air, not behind or across the girl's head. The water must clearly originate OFF SCREEN LEFT, never from the child. End with child safely supported in left arm, both partially sheltered by the right pillar.
